status: POST-OUTCOME v2 local-only census configuration. Nine iteration probes complete; full production grid not run.
seeding: Same randomly chosen known-positive document for every method in a topic/seed pair; seed counts as one review; discovery/search cost excluded.
topic_selection: Selected before any model runs for legal/judicial, performance, insolvency/liquidity, ownership changes and crime/law enforcement; no selection based on model results.
temporary_negatives: 100 random unreviewed documents, resampled each fit, never persisted as true labels
inference: Descriptive within-collection results. No significance or superiority claim across legal matters or IST leads.
stopping: Census budget 23,149 for all 180 runs; no target-recall early stopping. Local runner only.

extensions.explore_10: Use 10% random exploration for batches of at least 10

revision.reason: Fixed recall@1000 has topic-dependent mathematical ceilings and different prevalence-scaled review effort. Numerical optimization budget changed after observed non-convergence: nine high-ceiling refits needed 10,190–20,005 iterations; ceil(2*20005/1000)*1000=41000. C, loss, dual and tol unchanged. See diagnostics/iteration_requirements_v2/report.json. This numerical-budget change may affect rankings where previous optimization was incomplete; it is not a change to the model objective or acquisition algorithm.
